title: How Many Training Labels Are Wrong? Auditing a Fitted Model through Gradient Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22449v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How many labels in a training set are wrong, and which ones? The usual answers read a held-out set or the model's outputs. A held-out reading depends on how the held-out set was drawn, and an output-based reading fails once the model has fitted its wrong labels, because the loss of a fitted wrong label is small and the prediction agrees with it. We read the answer from the per-example gradients of a single trained model. Each example, together with its label, asks the network to change in a particular way. We normalise the magnitudes of its gradient into a gradient allocation and compare it with the mean allocation of every class. An example is flagged when relabelling it as its nearest other class makes its allocation fit better than under its own label, and the share of flagged examples is the reading of the noise rate. translated_title: 训练集中有多少标签是错的？通过梯度分配审计已拟合模型
translated_abstract: 训练集中有多少标签是错误的，具体是哪些？通常的答案要么读取一个保留集，要么读取模型的输出。基于保留集的读数取决于保留集的抽样方式，而基于输出的读数在模型拟合了错误标签之后就会失效，因为已拟合错误标签的损失很小，且预测与该错误标签一致。我们从单个训练好的模型的逐样本梯度中读取答案。每个样本连同其标签一起，会要求网络以某种特定方式发生变化。我们将梯度幅值归一化为一种梯度分配，并将其与每个类别的平均分配进行比较。当把某个样本重新标注为其最近的其他类别时，如果其梯度分配比在原标签下匹配得更好，该样本就被标记为可疑，而被标记样本所占的比例即为噪声率的读数。该规则无需阈值，也不需要干净数据、保留集或进一步的训练。在模型完成拟合之后……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需干净数据、保留集、阈值或再训练的方法，通过比较单个训练模型的逐样本梯度分配与各类平均分配来识别错误标签并估计训练集噪声率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a threshold-free method requiring no clean data, held-out set, or retraining, which detects mislabeled examples and estimates the training noise rate by comparing each example's gradient allocation from a single fitted model against per-class mean allocations.
